overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the committee had timely requested and received extensions to respond to the underlying complaints, so the later complaints about missed deadlines lacked merit.

allegations.summary: Eight complaints alleged the committee failed to timely respond to earlier Open Meeting Law complaints filed with it, under the 14-business-day rule.
allegations.key_passage: We find that when Mr. Fitzgerald filed the complaints addressed herein, the Committee was not in violation of the Law with regard to the timeliness of its responses to these complaints, as the Committee requested and was granted extensions of time to respond to the underlying complaints.
